historical_reviews.v3_1: Keeps IPMI chassis power-cycle semantics distinct from physical AC removal and requires explicit approval plus independent recovery for every service-impacting cycle plan.

original_test_intent: Stress repeated host power-off/on recovery for 500 IPMI OOB chassis power cycles while verifying management availability, console recovery, clean diagnostics and final system integrity.
original_method: On a dedicated recoverable SUT and approved power path, issue one supported chassis power cycle at a time with defined dwell, wait for bounded BMC/host/LAN/OS boot completion, record SOL/KVM recovery and diagnostic deltas, and stop on the first unsafe result.
manual_activity: Approve the dedicated target and power path, define whether the IPMI command performs a host DC cycle rather than AC removal, set off/on dwell, boot/reconnect deadlines and abort limits, and assign an operator for separate SOL/KVM observations.
required_inputs: Pinned reviewed script revision or equivalent approved procedure
safety_requirements: Never run on production, customer or shared power infrastructure
Do not claim physical AC cycling from `power cycle`
Issue the next cycle only after prior host boot and health are verified
Stop on power error, identity drift, boot timeout, lost OOB path, unexpected diagnostic or uncertain data integrity
Do not alter BIOS, boot or network configuration
agent_execution_scope: Validate IPMI action semantics and access
Poll BMC/LAN and host boot completion
Verify host identity and agreed data integrity
engineer_actions: Approve 500-cycle cadence, data scope and abort rules

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The IPMI action and count align with the source, but fixed cipher 17 is unvalidated, credentials are exposed, and a blind loop lacks power-state, dwell, host-boot and data-integrity gates. Calling it AC-style is not justified by the command.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved secret-backed IPMI chassis power-cycle action once per cycle, then verify off/on transition, BMC/LAN and host boot recovery, console reconnection, data scope and log deltas before continuing.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 500 IPMI power cycles and 20/1440 timing fields remain; cycle interval, dwell, command electrical semantics and recovery deadlines are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Track each cycle through command acceptance, actual host off/on states, boot completion, management and console recovery, data-integrity check and diagnostic delta.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes plaintext credentials and blind looping, corrects the unsupported AC characterization, and adds power-domain identity, dwell, boot/data gates and per-cycle abort evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Validates IPMI-controlled chassis power cycling only; it does not test PDU-controlled AC removal, BMC power loss, graceful shutdown or other reset types.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A command success can precede incomplete host power transition, and repeated cycles can corrupt active data or stress power components. BMC availability alone cannot prove host boot or data integrity.

project_override_considerations: If the platform documents `power cycle` as a particular DC or platform-specific sequence, retain that specification in evidence. A separate PDU/AC cycle requires a separate authorized method and must not be silently substituted. Procedure's KVM and Criteria's SOL must remain separate checkpoints if both are required.
expected_evidence: Documented IPMI cycle semantics and channel/cipher
Per-cycle command, actual off/on state and dwell timestamps
BMC/LAN recovery and host boot-completion times
Host identity and approved data-integrity result
SOL reconnect timing and operator KVM observation
Final completed count and system state
No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure says keep KVM connected while Criteria requires SOL always connected, despite a host power-off interval that normally interrupts console service. The review preserves both interfaces and requires an approved reconnect-based acceptance definition without changing Master.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Power-cycle semantics, dwell, recovery deadlines, console policy and data checks are identifiable package/approval inputs, so the case is REQUIRES rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Creates a state-verified host power-cycle test, prevents an IPMI DC-style action from being mislabeled as AC removal, and preserves the SOL/KVM contradiction for explicit acceptance resolution.
independent_technical_reasoning: An IPMI chassis power cycle is not automatically a physical AC cycle and may leave the BMC powered throughout. Therefore host off/on state, BMC reachability and console reconnection must be measured separately. The next command must wait for complete host boot or the test becomes a rapid power-interruption sequence with different risks. Because repeated ungraceful power loss can damage active data, a bounded integrity oracle is required in addition to final BMC health. Literal uninterrupted SOL/KVM service is incompatible with ordinary host power-off and needs explicit reconnect semantics.
